input.query: SELECT signup_month, SUM(n_signups) n, SUM(n_activated)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) activation, SUM(n_email_verified)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) email, SUM(n_kyc_started)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) kyc_start, SUM(n_doc_submitted)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) doc_submit, SUM(n_kyc_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) kyc_approved, SUM(n_first_topup)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) topup FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
